name: Apollo 14
intro: Al Shepard here. First American in space, and now I'm going to the Moon!
We're going to Fra Mauro, the site Apollo 13 never reached.
I've also sneaked a golf club head into my pocket. Don't tell anyone.
Remember: land with the Sun low, so the shadows show us the rocks.
briefing: A loose bit of solder is triggering the ABORT signal by itself!
Engineers are reprogramming the computer. Meanwhile, choose the site.
fact: Alan Shepard hit two golf balls on the Moon. One went 'miles and miles' (really about 40 m).

alarm.title: Phantom Abort Signal
alarm.briefing: The abort switch is sending fake signals! Engineers are typing a fix right now. Choose our landing site!
